column1: # Golden plaintext native-API frames — CAPTURED from aioesphomeapi itself, not
# hand-rolled. The payload is serialized by aioesphomeapi's vendored protobuf
# (`api_pb2`) and the frame wrapper by its own `_frame_helper.packets.
# make_plain_text_packets`, so every byte here is the REAL client's output. A
# round-trip against our own encoder would only prove self-consistency; matching
# these proves faithfulness to the wire (per the crate's two-oracle discipline —
# see PROVENANCE.md and tests/golden_ids.rs).
# Regenerate: tools/capture_frames.py against the pinned aioesphomeapi
# (commit 1e16d71, native-API 1.14). Columns are TAB-separated:
#   name <TAB> msg_type <TAB> frame_hex <TAB> payload_hex <TAB> note
# The frame is preamble(0x00) + varuint(len(payload)) + varuint(msg_type) +
# payload. The Rust test reconstructs each message from the same field values
# (hard-coded in tests/golden_frames.rs, kept in sync with capture_frames.py),
# encodes it, and asserts byte-equality with frame_hex; then decodes frame_hex
# and asserts it recovers msg_type + payload_hex.
